component.name: Krebs
component.summary: Minimalist Writing & Infinite Whiteboard Studio in Pure Rust

description.p: Krebs is an ultra-minimalist, distraction-free writing studio and infinite vector whiteboard engineered in 100% pure Rust. Built for thinkers, students, and authors who value speed, focus, and elegance.

ul.li: Distraction-Free Writing: Live Markdown split preview, custom typography (JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex, VT323), and smooth Word Wrapping.
Infinite Vector Whiteboard: Smooth low-latency drawing with Surface Pen / Wacom tablet support, math grids, dot paper, and quick erase.
AI Writing Coach: Built-in essay grading, CEFR rubrics, and support for Hermes 3, Claude 3.5, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek with instant offline heuristic fallback.
Trilingual Excellence: Native Bidirectional (LTR/RTL) support with Persian/Farsi shaping and integrated German exam connectors (Redemittel).
Complete Terminal Integration: Launch instantly from any terminal with the 'krabbe' command.

description.p: New assets & logo, Prompt Studio for building agent briefs, Language Teacher agent, Inter & Lora fonts, adjustable text size, Agent Studio modal with connection testing, and expanded offline AI fallback.
Initial release of Krebs Studio featuring resizable Live Split sections, infinite vector whiteboard with tablet stylus support, multi-agent AI selector, and terminal krabbe launcher.
